fichas.title: Guest house in a village environment — Hof der Stille
fichas.summary: A guest house created by converting a farm courtyard in an agricultural village near Berlin. The former farm buildings enclose an internal yard that provides central access, orientation, and a spatial and visual focus. Guest rooms in the former stables are apartment-like, with a wet cell and mini-kitchen arranged along the boundary wall.

fichas.title: Luxury hotel in an urban context — SIDE Hotel, Hamburg
fichas.summary: An urban-block hotel whose form combines a street-corner angle with a taller rearward block. An eighth-floor Sky Lounge and a naturally lit lobby form the central architectural element, mediating between street alignments and organizing the ensemble. Standard-floor guest rooms are mostly arranged around the lobby, with bathrooms parallel to the corridor in a one-sided access-gallery arrangement. Suites occupy corners and occur on the first and twelfth floors; restaurants and conference rooms are on the ground and first floors. Kitchens and administration occupy the rear ground floor, while conference rooms, spa, swimming pool, car park, and services are in the basements.
